ideas.title: Number: magnitude, representation and arithmetic structure
ideas.mechanism: a number is a magnitude whose type, representation and operations are constrained by a closed arithmetic structure

ideas.title: Algebraic structure: expressions, identities, polynomials and discrete form
ideas.mechanism: an algebraic form encodes a relation that remains invariant under allowed rewrites; matrices, counting and sets are discrete instances of the same structural idea

ideas.title: Functions, sequences and mappings
ideas.mechanism: a function is a deterministic mapping; a sequence is a function on the counting numbers

ideas.title: Euclidean geometry, congruence, similarity and proof
ideas.mechanism: a geometric claim is licensed by axioms, congruence/similarity criteria and invariant measures, not by the look of a diagram

ideas.title: Measure, mensuration and trigonometric ratio
ideas.mechanism: measure assigns magnitude to a geometric object via a unit and a formula; trigonometric ratios are measures of angle realised as length ratios

ideas.title: Analytic geometry, vectors and spatial representation
ideas.mechanism: location in a coordinate or vector space represents a geometric object so that algebraic operations become geometric operations

ideas.title: Change and accumulation: limits, derivatives and integrals
ideas.mechanism: instantaneous change and accumulation are inverse operations on a function, licensed by a limit

ideas.title: Chance, data and statistical reduction
ideas.mechanism: chance is a measure on a sample space; a statistic is a licensed reduction of a collection, not the collection itself

ideas.title: Place value, decimals and standard form
ideas.mechanism: the value of a digit is determined by its place in a positional system

ideas.title: Ratio, proportion and percentage
ideas.mechanism: a ratio is a comparison of two magnitudes that is preserved under uniform scaling

ideas.title: Counting, permutations, combinations and binomial form
ideas.mechanism: a counting principle enumerates arrangements under a stated constraint; the binomial expansion is the generating form of that count

ideas.title: Equations and inequalities as solution sets
ideas.mechanism: an equation asserts equality of two forms; solving is rewriting that preserves the solution set

ideas.title: Function as object: domain, range, inverse and composition
ideas.mechanism: a function is an object with domain, range and composition rules; invertibility is a property of that object, not of a formula shape

ideas.title: Geometric proof, congruence and similarity criteria
ideas.mechanism: a proof is a licensed chain from stated criteria; diagram features are not themselves reasons

ideas.title: Trigonometric ratios, identities and solution of triangles
ideas.mechanism: a trigonometric ratio is a length ratio in a right triangle (or its unit-circle extension) whose identities are algebraic consequences of that definition

ideas.title: Derivative as instantaneous rate of change
ideas.mechanism: the derivative is the limit of an average rate; it is not the average rate and not the value of the function

ideas.title: Conditional probability and independence
ideas.mechanism: conditional probability re-normalises a measure onto a restricted event; independence is a factorisation, not a causal slogan
